preservedResponsibilities: Original published type-provider methods return actual Type and byte Sequences. Normal generated static MI type factory includes implicit XInterface and shares its original cached pointer cell; deprecated Reference getter and static_type use actual UnoType. As with existing normal generated API bindings, incomplete normal reflection is preserved; comprehensive method metadata is not invented. Actual shared Type/Any/Reference/Sequence/typelib/OSL owners are reused. TypeScript structural interface casts retain a single object identity; explicit low-level pointer-adjustment callbacks represent compiler casts only. Original LP64 recursive base-offset increments are retained for concrete facet callers; physical C++ object layout/ABI is not certified. Synchronous execution replaces native mutex/barrier syntax. No alternative UNO type registry, runtime inferred interface provider, allocator, fake component or generic exception bridge is introduced. Native aggregation/component/inheritance helper families outside WeakImplHelper and full native reflection remain unported. Six focused cases use actual typelib records and component references; whole-module/native compiled differential parity remains unverified. CellColorHandler, complete DOCX/XLSX model/export and desktop/mobile file UI paths remain incomplete.
